name: Beads (bd)
description: A command-line task tracker for AI agents that keeps tasks as a linked graph in a version-controlled local database, plus a small "remember" command for durable project facts.
source_note: From its own documentation; nothing installed or tested.

installs_as.value: CLI (bd) that installs hooks, skills and AGENTS.md text

offline_no_account.value: Yes: embedded local database, no key or account

plain_files.value: No: Dolt database; the JSONL file is only an export

footprint.value: Small: one CLI with an embedded database

claude_code.value: Yes: bd setup claude installs a SessionStart hook

codex.value: Yes: bd setup codex installs skill, AGENTS.md text, hooks

survives_crash.value: Power loss is named as a corruption risk; repair steps exist

survives_compaction.value: Yes: SessionStart hook fires again after compaction

undo_delete.value: Version-controlled database; no undo command documented

service_failure.value: Embedded mode has no separate service

uninstall.value: bd setup claude --remove removes hooks; data folder separate
